scientific_integrity: The all-graph theorem follows from an explicit PL orbit triangulation, a good cover of monomer stars and the contractible-subcomplex quotient; finite exact checks are corroborative rather than an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: All diagonal board cells and symmetric off-diagonal cells are required; homotopy type is nonequivariant, while the automorphism action is on integral homology. No equivariant wedge splitting or other fixed-subgroup data is asserted. Potential unindexed equivalent loop-matching terminology remains a novelty risk.
title: Perfect matchings classify transpose-fixed graph-board chessboard complexes
